title_short: Eliana Breo · AYH · United Under Love
headline: A Voya volunteer leader says her son is the source of her happiness, and that we can all be united under love.
story: Eliana leads volunteerism and giving at Voya. Asked if she is happy, she says she is so happy to be here. Her son is the source of her happiness.
As a first-generation Latina, she knows what a pair of shoes can do for an entrepreneur. Sorting shoes at the warehouse showed her the first stop on their journey.
She is excited for the next day's shoe drive and the students who will benefit. Her message: never underestimate the power of giving back. We can all be united under love.
